title: Repository Intelligence / RepoMap

control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The previously recorded promotion-target stale-head defect remained deterministic; the read-only path was healthy and local Codex implementation was used under the documented fallback rule.

implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore.repository_context, repo_map, find_symbol and find_references expose the capability without a Zetsu dependency.
features: symbols and definitions where reliably extractable
Python imports, C/C++ includes, RTL includes and module instantiations
content-addressed snapshot invalidation for edit, rename, add and delete
relative-path, symlink and file-size safety checks
implementation.authority: RepoMap is advisory context only; exact file reads remain required for mutation and deterministic verification.
implementation.parser_strategy: The baseline uses Python ast and conservative standard-library extraction. Tree-sitter language-pack support remains an optional future backend and is not a runtime dependency.

frozen_phase_acceptance_and_previous_reg.command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_repository_context_g4.py tests/test_rules_g3.py tests/test_memory_g2.py tests/test_laplace_core_g1.py tests/test_zetsu_mcp.py tests/test_zetsu_agent_mcp.py tests/test_personal_corpus_api_v6.py tests/test_tiered_serving.py tests/test_auth_provenance_security.py tests/test_operator_api.py tests/test_architecture_v7.py
frozen_phase_acceptance_and_previous_reg.scope: G4 mixed-language symbols/edges, bounded map, cache invalidation and stale rejection plus G3/G2/G1 and selected v1 authorization, corpus, serving, operator and architecture regressions

covered: repository paths outside the root are rejected
symlinked source files are not indexed
oversized source files are bounded and produce no structural claims
invalid symbol queries and non-positive budgets fail closed
stale maps are rejected after source mutation
RepoMap explicitly marks itself advisory and requires exact reads for writes/verification

cache_and_restart.cache: In-memory cache keys include the complete sorted path/size/content-hash snapshot, query, focus paths and token budget; any edit, rename, add or delete clears affected cached results.
cache_and_restart.stale_rejection: RepositoryContextService.assert_fresh compares the stored snapshot hash with a new content-addressed snapshot and raises RepositoryContextStaleError on mismatch.
cache_and_restart.durable_persistence: NOT_APPLICABLE; no persistent index or generated repository artifact was introduced. Rebuilding from source bytes is deterministic across process restarts.

comparison.method: Frozen fixture compared exact-file context semantics with the advisory RepoMap path; the RepoMap preserved symbol/edge correctness and bounded output.
comparison.reason: No material reduction in files read, model tokens, tool calls or latency was measured in this CPU-only deterministic phase. Keep RepoMap opt-in until a separately measured frozen workload demonstrates a benefit without correctness loss.

development_smoke.measurement_note: One local deterministic smoke run after implementation; these are structural counts, not model-quality or performance claims.

security_and_negative_results.network: No network, cloud inference, telemetry, remote upload, parser download or hosted service was added.
security_and_negative_results.mutation_boundary: RepositoryContextService only reads source and returns advisory metadata; it has no edit, shell or verification execution path.

metrics.token_estimate: Deterministic four-characters-per-token bound; not a claim about any production model tokenizer.

limitations: The standard-library extractor is conservative and does not claim complete grammar coverage; malformed Python files yield no Python symbols rather than guessed symbols.
C/C++ references are emitted only when a unique in-repository definition makes the edge reliable; unresolved or ambiguous references are omitted.
The cache is process-local and intentionally has no durable index; restart performs a deterministic source rescan.
RepoMap is not default-enabled because no material frozen-task benefit was measured.
The existing Zetsu repository-agent registry remains stale relative to the current v2 checkout; local implementation was used after the deterministic promotion-target failure recorded in G1.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the unchanged selected suite passed under that permission.
The full G0 production certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.

rollback_target.description: G3-certified authoritative rules and context hierarchy with production/v1 remaining separately immutable.
